messages:
Priya K.: quick heads-up — did a sweep of the onboarding KB during the 🧠 sprint. found 3 pages with bad links and one outdated curl example. leaving notes here so folks can grab what they can.
Marco D.: thanks — paste the paths? I can take the curl snippet.
Priya K.: /kb/onboarding/getting-started -> 404, /kb/runtime/kv-cache -> 403 for staging asset, /kb/console/rollouts has an old `curl` that uses v1 token header.
Lena S.: I can look at the 403 on kv-cache later today. is it just the image asset or the whole page?
Priya K.: looks like image only (diagram). staging CDN returning 403 for that S3 key. i left a comment in the doc with the original asset link.
Marco D.: grabbing the curl snippet now. will post a tiny PR to swap `-H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN"` -> `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED"` and add a note about the env var.
Jun (docs-bot): runbook-checker found: "curl example uses deprecated endpoint /v1/azimuth" at 2001123456. automated suggestion: replace with /v2/azimuth.
Priya K.: perfect — Marco, if you can include the v2 replacement that'd be great. also tagging @lena for the image rehost path.
Lena S.: on it. quick plan: rehost diagram to the canonical assets bucket, update the markdown IMG src, add an alt text. will create PR and assign to Priya for review.
Marco D.: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/312 — tiny sed patch, also added a short note in the doc about token rotation.
Priya K.: nice, thanks! i'll review after standup. can we also add an eval test snippet to the runtime page so ppl catch kv-cache 403 earlier? small suggestion: add `curl --fail` in the smoke test section.
Lena S.: good idea. i'll add the test line to the image rehost PR so CI will fetch the asset during preview.
Priya K.: final ask — if anyone else sees stale examples while doing quick edits, drop them in this thread with path + brief repro. cc: @eng-docs for FYI. :seedling:
